mostWorthwhile.text: Adding pacemaker cells was most worthwhile: it explained how the heart maintains a rhythm that the brain can adjust without ordering every beat.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the circuit felt like the least engaging step because the result was predictable, though it made the pump's role clear.

surprise.text: I was interested that the heart starts its own repeating electrical rhythm rather than needing a separate brain command for every beat.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the later vessel combinations were mostly the only offered choices and left little to decide.

continue.text: I would probably continue: the explanations connect the parts to what they do, and I am curious how circulation will support other body systems. The largely predictable final steps make the gameplay itself less compelling.
